scenario: [LEXP.7.14.1]: the shift count is never reduced modulo 64. `-8 >> 64` is floor(-8 / 2^64) = -1; masked, it reads `-8 >> 0` = -8. Both operands come from slots so nothing folds at compile time. Guard `(t.x >> t.n) == -1` gates the emit; fact_count 2 confirms it fired. Path: rete/eval.c's SHR arm into int_ops.h's ds_i64_shr (formal/saw/i64_shr.saw); Mercury ds.eval.bit_result.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key
    n: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.x >> t.n) == -1
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
